headline: Riverton city council approves budget that raises transit fares
snippet: The council voted 6-3 on Tuesday night after a four-hour public hearing.
summary: Riverton's city council voted 6-3 on Tuesday to approve a $2.1 billion budget that raises bus and rail fares by 25 cents, according to multiple outlets. Supporters on the council said the increase closes a transit deficit; opponents said it will burden lower-income riders. The mayor said she will sign the budget this week.
keyFacts: Bus and rail fares rise by 25 cents starting in March.
The mayor said she will sign it.
